entries.change: Bind production assessment starts and crawler indexing to explicit deployment/model/public-launch gates; preview remains usable for beta verification.
entries.rationale: Prevent an ordinary deployment or model environment-variable change from silently making the beta C01D model public.

entries.change: Make production client-IP header selection explicit/fail-closed and define/test a per-table restricted PostgreSQL runtime role.
entries.rationale: Reduce trusted-proxy spoofing assumptions and prove runtime database DML does not require schema/admin privileges.

entries.change: Add isolated logical backup/restore rehearsal and explicitly model restoration of later-deleted diagnostic/share data as a production privacy blocker.
entries.rationale: A technically successful restore is insufficient if it resurrects data deleted after the backup timestamp.

entries.change: Replace runtime exception-object console logging with a fixed event/surface/category server-fault schema and prohibit direct runtime console.error bypasses.
entries.rationale: Operational logs must not accidentally serialize bearer capabilities, answers, result payloads, request data, stack traces or free-form exception content.

entries.change: Make 30/90/180-day diagnostic retention engineering windows executable with dry-run-first cleanup, explicit execute acknowledgement and PostgreSQL guards/integration.
entries.rationale: Retention promises need inspectable deletion mechanics rather than documentation-only intent.

entries.change: Remove the legacy public environment fallback for canonical site origin; preview/production require explicit PCS_SITE_ORIGIN and production requires HTTPS.
entries.rationale: Prevent misconfigured preview/production share and metadata URLs from silently falling back to localhost or a client-exposed configuration path.

entries.change: Expose implementation-grounded /privacy and /terms pre-launch drafts, link them from the landing footer, require noindex, and cover them in browser/legal validation.
entries.rationale: Make current privacy, diagnostic limitation, self-deletion, retention, backup and non-validation boundaries inspectable in the product before final legal approval without misrepresenting the draft as final terms.

entries.change: Add a 64-slot production asset registry and ingest validator requiring committed byte identity, real image dimensions, provenance, deterministic variant lineage and human approval checks before a type hero can be approved.
entries.rationale: Turn illustration production from a brief-only process into an auditable asset lifecycle without pretending unproduced C01D heroes exist.

entries.change: Introduce a canonical 16-record production evidence registry that exactly binds every public-launch and production-model activation external/manual evidence key.
entries.rationale: Prevent release gate status from advancing through unsupported pending-to-complete string edits without inspectable evidence metadata.
evidence: all current canonical evidence explicitly pending

entries.change: Add a provider-independent operator probe for HTTPS, health, security headers, HSTS, robots and noindex/indexability state with pure pass/fail evaluator tests.
entries.rationale: Turn several production deployment observations into repeatable JSON evidence without falsely proving environment separation, proxy ownership, secrets, database grants or monitoring provider configuration.
evidence: manual CLI emits privacy-bounded JSON report
production mode requires HTTPS and HSTS

entries.change: Generate and upload a release-candidate evidence pack only after full browser E2E, freezing Git SHA, Requirements version, exact model tuple, critical file hashes, migration-set hash, art-production state and canonical pending production evidence.
entries.rationale: A green badge alone does not identify the exact source/model/migration state that passed release-grade CI; the pack makes that state inspectable without including secrets or claiming production/validation.

entries.change: Add a 16-threat asset/trust-boundary threat model with repository mitigations, test evidence, residual risk and canonical external-evidence bindings.
entries.rationale: Prepare external security review from an inspectable model and ensure partially mitigated production risks cannot be mislabeled complete without the corresponding deployment/manual evidence.
evidence: QA-007 forced open while external review pending

entries.change: Add GitHub CodeQL JavaScript/TypeScript security-extended analysis on main pushes, pull requests and weekly schedule, plus a normal-CI contract preventing silent workflow removal.
entries.rationale: Supplement project-specific security validators with independent static code analysis while keeping external security review as a separate unresolved gate.

entries.change: Promote production retention scheduler evidence and production log-provider privacy review to explicit canonical public-launch blockers.
entries.rationale: Repository cleanup/logging implementations do not prove their scheduled production execution or hosting-provider log retention/access/enrichment behavior; those properties must not be hidden inside generic monitoring/QA completion.

entries.change: Add a separate versioned calibration consent-purpose contract and consent receipt persistence while keeping runtime collection/export disabled and denying the normal runtime DB role all consent-table privileges.
entries.rationale: Advance closed-beta research governance without turning ordinary diagnosis/product analytics into psychometric research data or silently collecting answer-level calibration data.
entries.compatibility_impact: no-current-runtime-collection-surface; future activation requires explicit DB-role/API/policy version change
evidence: database least-privilege integration proving zero runtime table access
owner deletion integration proving receipt cascade

entries.change: Add a strict offline calibration export record/manifest schema and pure-domain validator that rejects unknown/private fields and mixed model/wave scopes without creating any runtime export route or job.
entries.rationale: Freeze the minimum research-data shape before activation so future calibration cannot ad hoc export session capabilities, derived results, timing, demographics, linkage or analytics data.

entries.change: Add a fail-closed calibration research operator persistence plane with hash-only operator credentials, explicit roles, two-person export-request state, append-only bounded audit storage, pseudonymous calibration record linkage and append-only withdrawal/session-deletion events.
entries.rationale: Calibration raw-export tooling must not be implemented before privileged operator separation, accountability and withdrawal-targeted deletion invariants exist at the database layer.

entries.change: Add an offline calibration operator credential lifecycle CLI with one-time 256-bit token issuance, SHA-256 hash-only DB identity, environment-only authentication, role management/revocation and dedicated least-privilege calibration auth/admin DB role contracts.
entries.rationale: Privileged research export tooling must not be built on migration-owner or ordinary runtime credentials, and operator secrets must not leak through argv/stdout/logs.
evidence: exact auth/admin DB privilege matrix integration

entries.change: Freeze the Wave JA-01 repository candidate measurement scope using an exact version tuple plus ordered SHA-256 identities for 15 canonical assessment/item/scoring/Trait/interaction/code-schema sources.
entries.rationale: External preregistration must reference an immutable candidate. Version labels alone cannot detect silent semantic byte changes under the same label, while freezing the entire Git commit would over-couple unrelated repository work.
entries.assessment_model_impact: assessment-dev-v0.3-remains-beta; exact Wave-JA-01 candidate bytes are now repository-frozen without production activation
entries.code_schema_impact: core-code-v0.1-dev is frozen only as assessment release context; public_use remains false
entries.content_impact: content-dev-v0.3 version identity is release context only; diagnostic content is not scientifically validated by this freeze
entries.compatibility_impact: semantic changes to the frozen candidate now require a new freeze version/new wave or documented amendment; unrelated non-frozen repository files remain changeable
evidence: SHA-256 known-vector and adversarial mutation/order/missing-file tests

entries.change: Add an offline calibration export request/review/approve/reject control plane backed by execute-only SECURITY DEFINER PostgreSQL functions and a dedicated zero-table-privilege pcs_calibration_export_control role; harden pcs_calibration_auth to the same execute-only pattern.
entries.rationale: Direct table SELECT/DML for authentication or export control would allow a DB credential to enumerate operator credential hashes or impersonate arbitrary operator IDs. Credential-derived identity, role checks, frozen Wave scope and two-person approval therefore must be enforced inside a bounded DB API before any raw materializer exists.
entries.assessment_model_impact: none-assessment-dev-v0.3 remains beta and raw materialization/collection/export stay disabled
entries.data_migration_impact: 0010 adds security-definer control functions only; no participant or answer-level calibration table is added
entries.compatibility_impact: whoami changes from direct auth-table SELECT to execute-only DB function; normal pcs_runtime remains zero-access; raw materializer remains absent
evidence: exact all-table privilege + function execute matrix

entries.change: Add purpose-separated normalized calibration_records and calibration_item_responses tables under existing pseudonymous calibration_record_links, with exact Wave JA-01/model/item constraints, 147-response finalization, immutable item rows and zero runtime/operator privileges.
entries.rationale: A real closed-beta pipeline needs answer-level psychometric data, but reusing diagnostic assessment_answers would collapse purpose/retention boundaries. A dedicated fail-closed schema establishes integrity and deletion semantics before any runtime ingest or export materializer is authorized.
entries.assessment_model_impact: none-assessment-dev-v0.3 remains beta; storage schema is fixed to its frozen Wave JA-01 tuple but no calibration rows are collected
entries.code_schema_impact: none-C01D remains public_use=false and derived codes are prohibited from calibration answer storage
entries.data_migration_impact: 0011 adds normalized calibration record/item-response tables and DB validation/finalization triggers/functions; no ingest role or runtime route is added
entries.compatibility_impact: ordinary diagnostic persistence remains unchanged; future calibration ingest/purge/retest/materializer work must use the separate pseudonymous tables and cannot silently reuse assessment_answers
evidence: withdrawal journal plus owner-session cascade test

entries.change: Add a fail-closed privacy-preserving test-retest linkage foundation on completed calibration_records with random pair IDs, hash-only one-time claim credentials, distinct baseline/retest consent identities, exact 14–21 day DB enforcement and pair-level withdrawal/deletion journaling.
entries.rationale: Wave JA-01 requires test-retest evidence, but reusing account/email or diagnostic session bearers would expand identity/capability exposure. The linkage must be purpose-separated, pseudonymous, scope-bound and purge-addressable before any runtime retest flow is authorized.
entries.assessment_model_impact: none-assessment-dev-v0.3 remains beta and repository-frozen; retest pairs require that exact completed calibration-record scope
entries.code_schema_impact: none-C01D remains public_use=false and derived codes are forbidden from candidate retest export
entries.data_migration_impact: 0012 adds calibration_retest_linkages, dual baseline/retest consent support for the existing answer-storage guards, and pair invalidation/deletion-journal triggers; no runtime grants are added
entries.compatibility_impact: baseline export v0.1 remains unchanged; retest uses candidate-only v0.2 schema; runtime issue/claim/materialization remain disabled
evidence: real PostgreSQL completed-record 14–21 day linkage integration

entries.change: Add an offline two-person calibration row purge workflow for pseudonymous records that already carry a qualifying consent-withdrawn, owner-session-deleted, or retest-pair-invalidated event; add an execute-only zero-table-privilege privacy-control DB role.
entries.rationale: The repository already journals withdrawal/invalidation targets but had no controlled executor. Direct DELETE privileges would create arbitrary participant-data deletion capability, so eligibility and two-person authorization are enforced inside SECURITY DEFINER functions. Artifact purge remains coupled to any future raw materializer because no artifact store exists yet.
entries.assessment_model_impact: none-assessment-dev-v0.3 remains frozen beta and collection/export remain disabled
entries.data_migration_impact: 0013 adds bounded purge request/target governance tables and execute-only purge functions; confirmed purge deletes only already-journaled calibration_records and cascaded responses
entries.compatibility_impact: ordinary runtime remains zero-access; export control remains separate; future raw materializer cannot activate without artifact lineage plus purge/regeneration
